name: kompact
description: Local, offline context compaction: scores every tool call and keeps only what is still needed verbatim. No API key, no GPU, no network call. The built-in logistic scorer measures AUC 0.905 ± 0.078 over ten grouped splits of 1063 labelled calls, against 0.719 ± 0.026 for the best zero-shot Laya checkpoint it replaced, which it beat on 10 of 10 paired splits.

keepThreshold.title: Keep floor
keepThreshold.description: Probability at or above which a call is never dropped, whatever the reduction target. Raise it to keep more. Re-swept against the coefficients fitted on 41 sessions: 0.2 retains 85.4% of outputs that were genuinely reused later and frees 20.7%; 0.25 retains 83.0% and frees 26.0%; past 0.25 it falls off a cliff, with 0.3 freeing 50.7% by keeping only 58.3%.

targetReduction.title: Reduction target
targetReduction.description: Fraction of droppable tool-output characters to free, 0-1. Calls are dropped lowest-score-first until this is met, then dropping stops. Measured: 0.5 frees 23.4% of tool output, keeps 77.3% of the outputs reused later and 92.2% of their characters; 0.7 frees 33.9% and keeps 68.8%.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Newest messages pinned from compaction; the first message is always kept.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Below this estimated character reduction, delegate to the built-in summary instead.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a dropped tool result kept, so a wrong drop costs a re-run and not the content.

minYieldChars.title: Min yield chars
minYieldChars.description: Fewest characters a drop must actually free to be worth making. Default 200. Below this the context saved cannot repay the chance of losing content the session still needs.

recordSignals.title: Record what you repeat
recordSignals.description: Counts the shapes of the commands, requests and tool sequences you repeat, locally, so `npm run propose` can rank them and draft skills for the top ones. Signatures plus up to three redacted examples, kept in the plugin's own store and mirrored to ~/.claude/kompact-signals.json. Nothing leaves the machine and no raw output is stored. Set to false to record nothing at all.

maxKeptChars.title: Cap on a kept result
maxKeptChars.description: Longest a KEPT tool result may be, in characters. Default 24000; 0 disables. Half of all tool output lives in about 3% of calls, so this frees 26.8% against 24.2% for the ranking alone while leaving the per-session worst case identical. 16000 nearly doubles the median session saving and costs one more session that keeps under half of what it later quoted.
